blocks.content: Write a program to remove the front and back elements of a list.

items: Get four integer inputs from the users and store them in input1, input2, input3, and input4 variables.
Declare an integer list called numbers.
Add each input value to the back of the list.
Remove the front and back elements from the list.
Print the updated list in a separate line.

blocks.content: Hint: Use pop_front() and pop_back() to remove the front and back elements from the list.
